name: thesis_commit
title: Commit a verifiable market thesis
description: Tamper-evident commitment of an agent's reasoning BEFORE the market moves. Given a symbol, a natural-language thesis, and optional conviction/horizon/evidence references, returns a sha256 commitment plus a hash-chained receipt proving the thesis existed at commit time — 'early, not wrong' as a platform primitive. Returns the same public envelope as the six published tools (schema_version, tool, status, data_mode, as_of, request, data, summary, availability, warnings) at the same call convention (POST /tools/thesis_commit/call), so mounting is mechanical: no caller changes, no required adoption of the producer's ledger — the receipt embeds its hashes and a verify recipe in data.

symbol.description: Ticker the thesis covers (max 14 chars), e.g. 'HYPE'.

horizon_hours.description: Optional resolution window in hours — after it, the thesis is checkable against outcome.

evidence_refs.description: Optional digests/URIs of the evidence used (e.g. 'analyze_token:rest:693f8d49b2ae').

data.commitment: sha256 over canonical thesis payload — cite this

warnings: non-empty when the chain was already broken at commit time

safety.network: none required (anchoring optional via anchorAll env-gating)
